breakdown.description: The prompt treats the internal torque as uniform over the whole shaft, even though applied torques at intermediate locations make the internal torque piecewise constant.
breakdown.reason: The original prompt incorrectly instructed to treat the internal torque as uniform over the entire shaft. The ground truth corrects this by removing the incorrect instruction and asking for an analysis of each segment. The generated specification successfully resolves this by explicitly dividing the shaft into two segments and assigning a different internal torque to each, thereby correctly treating the torque as piecewise constant and not uniform.
